mapping.justification: Explicit test interpretation; integer height is not a theorem mapping prime labels to zeros.

method.methodRouting: Source-inspected mpmath 1.3.0: the explicit borwein setting does not select the fast path; use default versus the explicit Euler-Maclaurin path at these heights.

inputShiftComparison.candidateRule: Same unrotated quadrant pair as n=97
inputShiftComparison.scope: Finite diagnostic of the requested zeta(s), zeta(s+1) input shift, not an optimized or validated prime predictor.

finding.scope: Fixed mapping s=1/2+i*n, n=2..100, target and basis zero. Refutes a quadrant-only perfect test on this finite range.

limits: No claim that every richer phase-based method is impossible.
Labels come from exact divisibility and are used only as ground truth, not in zeta evaluation.
High-precision agreement is numerical evidence, not an interval-certified zero or RH proof.
No new prime formula, speedup, or zeta-based prime classifier is established.
